third_party_inputs_flagged.label: Same-week cross-game ATS leg dependence: observed vs market-implied expected joint covers
third_party_inputs_flagged.method: observed joint both-cover rate vs sum of de-vig market cover probabilities over within-week unordered pairs
third_party_inputs_flagged.inputs: market-implied probabilities (third-party odds, multiplicative de-vig) + official scores
third_party_inputs_flagged.reading: A negative gap means cross-game parlay legs both cover slightly LESS often than independence assumes; a positive gap means slightly more. This is the parlay leg-dependence adjustment this namespace prices with.

third_party_inputs_flagged.reading: The model tracks the market loosely (r≈0.73-0.75); its disagreements are what the leaderboard grades.

method_note: Pearson r for continuous pairs; phi for binary pairs (numerically identical to Pearson on 0/1); 95% CI via Fisher z. n published with every value.
